skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the requirements, concepts, and basic methodologies of architectural design, research, and analysis.
Ability to read and analyze basic contents of architectural design drawings.
Understanding the requirements and characteristics of residential architecture.
Understanding the characteristics and design principles of industrial architecture.
Understanding the principles and quality assessment of urban settlement planning.
Develop communication, teamwork, decision-making, and project management skills.
Understanding social context and having independent viewpoints, teamwork, and personal responsibility.
Recognizing ethical responsibilities and social responsibilities, analyzing social contexts and work environments.
